title: The Teng Family
summary: In Teng Family City, Zhang Hu tries to sell a thousand-year blood ginseng and is ambushed, and Wang Lin is attacked by Teng disciples hunting Bai Zhan's killer. Teng Li, at late Foundation Establishment, takes Zhang Hu, lures Wang Lin in, and tries to take his blood-refined little sword. Wang Lin, still in Qi Condensation, holds him off with tricks and breaks the lantern formation that blocks flying in the city. Grandfather Teng then lets Teng Li use a Nascent Soul-grade flying sword even if it costs the city, and Situ Nan has to teleport Wang Lin away again and again, draining his own Nascent Soul power. Wang Lin flees into the Mysterious Forest five hundred miles south, full of miasma and the qi-draining Blue Thread Vine. Teng Li follows with his Black Gold Heart Mirror, and Wang Lin swears to cut off the root of anyone who wrongs him twice.
events: Zhang Hu haggles over the blood ginseng and is ambushed

cultivation: Teng Li: late Foundation Establishment. Wang Lin is still in Qi Condensation. Situ Nan's Nascent Soul power is badly depleted and he can only teleport a few more times.
